WatchlistItem.title: WatchlistItem
WatchlistItem.description: A user's saved Steam game with a target price alert threshold.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this watchlist entry.

gameTitle.description: Display title of the watched Steam game.

targetPriceEur.description: Target price threshold in EUR for price alerts.

preferredCurrency.description: Currency selected when setting the target price.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FollowedWorkshopGame.title: FollowedWorkshopGame
FollowedWorkshopGame.description: A Steam game followed by the user for new Workshop mod updates.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this followed game.

appId.description: Steam AppID of the followed game.

gameName.description: Display name of the followed game.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when followed via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

FollowedWorkshopMod.title: FollowedWorkshopMod
FollowedWorkshopMod.description: A Steam Workshop mod bookmarked by the user or synced from their public Steam subscriptions.

userId.description: Authenticated Firebase user UID owning this followed mod.

source.description: Origin of the followed mod entry.

updatedEpochSec.description: Last updated epoch timestamp in seconds (0 if unknown).

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

SteamWorkshopSyncProfile.title: SteamWorkshopSyncProfile
SteamWorkshopSyncProfile.description: Linked Steam profile metadata for syncing public Steam Workshop subscriptions.

profileInput.description: Original Steam profile URL or SteamID64 entered by the user.

syncedCount.description: Number of subscribed mods found in the last sync.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

/users/{userId}/watchlist/{gameId}.description: User-scoped watchlist and target price alerts keyed by gameId.

/users/{userId}/followed_games/{appId}.description: User-scoped followed Steam games for the Workshop new mods feed.

/users/{userId}/followed_mods/{published.description: User-scoped bookmarked and Steam-synced Workshop mods.

/users/{userId}/workshop_sync/{syncId}.description: User-scoped linked Steam profile sync metadata.
